# Lyrascent Learning

> Lyrascent Learning is a personal AI tutor for K-12 children: math, reading, science, languages and typing in one place, with hints that teach instead of just giving the answer. It is not open to the public yet; a few families are being invited first.

## What it does
- A quick check-in finds where each child is, then a quest map unlocks one skill at a time
- An AI tutor the child can chat with; the tutor can make mistakes, so parents stay in charge
- Parents set screen-time limits; no ads
- Language practice in Spanish, Chinese, Vietnamese, French and Japanese

## Not offered
It is not a licensed school and gives no grades, transcripts or accreditation.

## Prices
There are no prices yet.

## Contact
- Email (parents): hello@lyrascent.com for early access
